question: Which team was honoured as “Team of the Year” at the Laureus World Sports Awards in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Real Madrid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Real Madrid** was honoured as the “**Team of the Year**” at the **Laureus World Sports Awards** in **April 2025**. This recognition is given to the team that has demonstrated exceptional performance, sportsmanship, and achievements in the past year.
 
• The decision was based on **Real Madrid's extraordinary performance** in the **2024/2025 football season**, including winning major tournaments and showcasing dominance in European football.
 
• **Real Madrid** had clinched the **UEFA Champions League** title in the 2024/2025 season, further solidifying their status as one of the best teams globally.
 
• The Laureus Awards, referred to as the “**Oscars of Sports**,” celebrate outstanding achievements in sports annually, and **Real Madrid** earned this prestigious accolade owing to their consistent excellence and global popularity.
 
• The award highlights the team's ability to adapt, innovate, and overcome challenges, making them an inspiration for millions of fans worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**

 
 
• Established in **2000**, the Laureus World Sports Awards are held annually to celebrate the achievements of athletes and teams across various sports disciplines.
 
• The awards are decided by members of the Laureus World Sports Academy, a unique group of sporting legends, making it one of the most prestigious recognitions in sports.
 
• Categories include **Sportsman of the Year, Sportswoman of the Year, Team of the Year**, and more.
 
• Notable past winners of the “**Team of the Year**” award include **Mercedes AMG Petronas Formula One Team**, **Germany National Football Team**, and **Chicago Cubs**.
 
 
 
• **Real Madrid:**
 
 
• **Location:** Based in **Madrid, Spain**, Real Madrid is one of the most famous and successful football clubs globally.
 
• Founded in **1902**, Real Madrid has a rich history of winning major tournaments, including **La Liga, Copa del Rey, and UEFA Champions League**.
 
• Known for their iconic white jerseys, Real Madrid is celebrated for their **attacking football style** and global fan base.
 
• Real Madrid's squad in the 2024/2025 season included **world-class players**, and their performances in key matches were instrumental in securing the Laureus award.
 
 
 
• **2024/2025 UEFA Champions League Victory:**
 
 
• Real Madrid defeated top teams to win their **15th Champions League title**, an unmatched record in European football history.
 
• Their tactics, teamwork, and resilience during the tournament were widely praised by analysts and fans.
 
• Key players, such as **Vinícius Júnior** and **Luka Modrić**, played crucial roles in their victory.
 
 
 
• **Other Contenders for Laureus “Team of the Year”:**
 
 
• **Bayern Munich:** Known for their dominance in the **Bundesliga**, but did not achieve the same level of international success as Real Madrid in 2024/2025.
 
• **Manchester City:** A strong competitor, but their performances in key tournaments fell short compared to Real Madrid's achievements.
 
• **Flamengo:** The Brazilian club had an impressive domestic season but lacked significant international recognition during the period.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Laureus Selection Process:**

 
 
• The winners are chosen by a panel of **sports experts** and legends, ensuring the awards reflect high standards of achievement.
 
• The selection process considers **performance, impact, and contribution** to the sport.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Award:**
 
 
• Winning the Laureus “**Team of the Year**” award cements a team’s legacy in global sports history.
 
• It showcases the team's **dedication and excellence**, motivating future generations of athletes.
 
 
 
• **Real Madrid's Global Influence:**
 
 
• Real Madrid is not just a football team but a **cultural phenomenon**, influencing sports, fashion, and entertainment worldwide.
 
• They boast one of the highest social media followings among sports teams, reflecting their global popularity.
